description: Fetch one connected marketplace in detail: every adapter on it with its setup state, last poll, last poll error, last catalog-sync outcome (`sync`, whose `lastSuccessAt` is the last run without a connection error — it survives failures, so it says how long a channel has been broken; `notAttempted` counts matched listings the run had no time left for and `truncated` true means not every listing was read — the next run continues, so a short `updated` with a large `notAttempted` is an unfinished run, not a skipped change) and last product import, a classified `problem` (kind, needsReconnect, platformMessage, whatToDo) when anything failed, `partialFailure` ({ failed, sent, sample, whatToDo }) when the last run connected fine but the marketplace refused some products (health stays active), and for google_merchant `sync.failedSample` (up to 5 refused products with Google's own message; the reason for those only, not every refused one), plus the channel sales, leads and product counts. For google_merchant each adapter also has `moderation` — what Google decided about the products the CRM sent, as the hourly check stored it (approved, pending, limited, rejected, missing, otherTarget, offChannel, topIssues, lastCheckedAt, complete, lastError; null before the first check; complete false means only part of the catalog was read) — and `setup`: setupBlock (what stands in the way: not_connected, no_account, no_country, no_terms, not_armed — owner setup, not an outage), armed, lastPreviewAt, feedLabel, currency, termsAccepted, productUrlTemplate and contentLanguageOverride. Reads stored state only, never calls the marketplace. Use list_marketplaces first to see which platforms are connected, list_channel_products for the products on the channel and check_channel_readiness for what would be refused.

platform.description: The marketplace slug returned by list_marketplaces (prom, rozetka, woocommerce, shopify, olx, amazon, ebay, google_merchant, vinted, etsy).

name: get_marketplace
